Trace 1 and Trace 2 both begin with a direct, step-by-step simulation of the state machine. Their approaches diverge after the first pass. Trace 1 performs a few targeted re-verifications of the trace and specific rules before concluding. Trace 2, however, embarks on an extensive series of re-checks, re-running the entire simulation multiple times and meticulously re-verifying individual events and registers. A notable divergence in Trace 2 is its exploration of the "READY" state's reachability; it opens a branch questioning whether a transition to READY was missed, systematically checks all transition rules, and concludes READY is unreachable (a CYCLE). Trace 1 never explores this. Trace 2's exhaustive re-checking leads to the same correct answer as Trace 1, but with significantly more redundant work.
